name: Florida
source: gun-policy Season 3 Stage 5, Florida session A hand-over (fl/HANDOVER-A.md part 7), 2026-11-14
sessions: Annual regular sessions plus numbered special sessions; bill numbers restart each year (LegiScan H0023-2023 regular and the 2023 third special session H0023 share an id form). House 120, Senate 40.
bill_data: LegiScan bulk datasets are on disk; never re-pull a dataset. LegiScan per-bill calls only.
Bill texts fetch direct from www.flsenate.gov, e.g. /Session/Bill/<year>/<n>/BillText/Filed/PDF.

votes.floor_rule: Every LegiScan floor roll call reads 'House: Third Reading RCS#n' or 'Senate: Third Reading RCS#n', amendment votes included. Keep the roll call whose date, chamber and tally match a bill-history passage, concurrence or failed line (Senate 'YEAS 20 NAYS 18'; House 'YEAS 76, NAYS 35', with a comma). Committee roll calls also appear; drop them.
gaps: The store already held two Florida bills under an older id form with 'HB' (FL-HB-543-2023, FL-HB-1365-2024); new files use one letter (FL-H-<n>-<year>). Look for both forms before adding a file.
Official roll-call PDFs (/Session/Bill/<year>/<n>/Vote/HouseVote_h0nnnn__<seq>.PDF) list members as 'Surname-district'.

texts.marks: House texts are PDF only (swapping /PDF for /HTML gives a page with no text); underline (new words) and strike-through (struck words) are drawn rectangles that pdftotext drops: recover them with pdftotext -bbox plus pdftocairo -svg (legiscan/scripts/fl_pdf_marks.py) as [+new+] / [-struck-]. Senate texts are HTML with <u class=Insert> and <s class=Remove>; join touching Insert runs, which lose spaces.
texts.note: Remove House PDF page headers ('CS/HB n yyyy') before quoting.

search_note: Official bill and roll-call pages are on www.flsenate.gov for both chambers; House member pages are on www.myfloridahouse.gov.
bill_table_note: See the texts marks: struck words are not in the operative text.
quirks: Some members appear under a former or longer surname in LegiScan (e.g. Demi Busatta = 'Demi Busatta Cabrera'); districts shifted with redistricting (a HD-20 member now sits for HD-21).
www.flsenate.gov robots.txt: 'Allow: /Session/', 'Crawl-delay: 10' (sleep 10 s between requests); roll-call PDF read 2026-11-14.
